enabled.label: Enable wet glass
enabled.description: Droplets pause while locked or in performance mode, and require wallpaper to be enabled.

density.label: Rain density
density.description: Amount of falling rain and opportunities for droplets to hit the glass.

speed.label: Rain speed
speed.description: Speed of background rain and small window impacts. Large sliding droplets have their own speed control.

windowDropletSpeed.label: Window droplet speed
windowDropletSpeed.description: Independent speed of the large sliding droplets on the glass. Zero freezes this layer without stopping background rain or smaller impacts.

dropletSize.label: Droplet size
dropletSize.description: Scale the mix of tiny beads, rounded drops, and larger sliding droplets.

refraction.label: Refraction strength
refraction.description: How strongly each clear glass-like droplet bends the wallpaper near its edges.

glassStrength.label: Glass intensity
glassStrength.description: Strength of purple-blue iridescence, white reflections, and edge lensing. Zero keeps clear refraction without the colored glass coating.

dropletLifetime.label: Droplet lifetime
dropletLifetime.description: Seconds before a droplet fades and a new impact can appear, at its layer's 1x speed. Shorter values mean faster turnover.

hitWindowPercentage.label: Hit window percentage
hitWindowPercentage.description: Chance that an eligible rain event forms a glass droplet. Zero shows background rain only; 100% lets every eligible event hit.

backgroundRain.label: Background rain
backgroundRain.description: Visibility of fast falling rain behind the glass droplets. Zero hides background particles.
